turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?
Return period:
EU/UK: 14-day statutory withdrawal (register via Return Portal), then 14 days to hand to carrier.
All customers: Voluntary 30-day return from receipt (items must be unused, complete, in original packaging).
How to return:
Register first via the 👉 Return Portal.
Options after registration:
Use our prepaid label (return fee may apply depending on country).
Use your own carrier at your own cost.
Free in-person return at our Flagship Stores (for online orders); store purchases must be returned in-store.
Return fees (when using our label):
EU mainland: €5 per package, max €15 per order.
UK: £20 per package, max £60 per order.
Switzerland: CHF 20 per package, max CHF 60 per order.
Outside EU mainland/UK/CH: you organise and pay return yourself; no label provided.
Defective items: we cover return costs after you contact us.
Refunds:
Issued to original payment method after the return is received and inspected.
Processing can take up to 8 business days from warehouse arrival; bank processing may add 5–8 business days.
If you return the entire order, we refund the cost of the cheapest standard shipping; if you keep at least one item, original shipping is not refunded.
If items show use beyond normal inspection, we may deduct depreciation.
If our prepaid label is used, the return fee is deducted from the refund.
Refunds may be split if your return arrives in multiple packages, and discounts may be recalculated if conditions are no longer met.
Other points:
Direct exchanges are not possible; please return and place a new order. More info 👉 here.
If you’ve registered a return but decide to keep the item, simply don’t send it back; the registration expires automatically.
In some cases after the 30 days, we may make an exception if the item is completely unused and in original packaging—this is assessed individually.
If you need more individual clarification about your case, please contact our Customer Care Team via the 👉 Contact Form.
